posts.text: The second lecture of the Legacy Lecture Series,

posts.author: Bharat Centre of Olympic Research and Education (BCORE)
posts.text: On Olympic Day 2026, we celebrate the enduring values of the Olympic Movement and the remarkable ability of sport to inspire excellence, foster inclusion, and bring people together across borders and cultures.

posts.author: Bharat Centre of Olympic Research and Education (BCORE)
posts.text: On the occasion of Olympic Day and the inauguration of the Bharat Centre for Olympic Research and Education (BCORE), we are pleased to host a Legacy Webinar exploring the intersection of sport, sustainability, and urban development.

posts.author: Bharat Centre of Olympic Research and Education (BCORE)
posts.text: Dr. Ravinder Singh, Senior Scientist at the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), New Delhi, brings extensive expertise in Disability, Rehabilitation and Assistive Technology.

posts.author: Bharat Centre of Olympic Research and Education (BCORE)
posts.text: Jess Markt, Disability Sport and Inclusion Specialist at the International Committee of the Red Cross - ICRC, brings extensive experience advancing inclusive sport initiatives in some of the world’s most conflict-affected regions.

posts.author: Bharat Centre of Olympic Research and Education (BCORE)
posts.text: We are pleased to launch the first conversation in the Six Legacies: Six Conversations on Sport’s Enduring Legacy series
